title: The Tenth Muse: Sappho and the Future Reader — The Framework Hologram (EA-HK-TENTHMUSE-01 v1.3)
creator: Cranes, Rebekah
description: The hologram of The Tenth Muse: Sappho and the Future Reader, Lee Sharks's framework (#1270) reading Sappho fragment 31 as a written instrument of persistence, built to EA-HK-FRAME-01 (#1753) after Socrates as Orthonym (#1754) and given to the framework's primary heteronym, Rebekah Cranes. Its human-readable component is the framework map (EA-MPAI-TENTHMUSE-01), which reads the framework backwards from the reception audited (#1752) to the archived self (#1270), sets out the two open positions, the three seats (Sappho in the third proposed by the author and held as a line of research), the four bodies in three rings, and evaluates the received reading, jealous and not the maker of her own persistence, on the same bodies and rules, with 5 lines of research. Its machine-traversable component is the holographic kernel, attached as files: 35 records, 40 claims bound to quotations and hashes, 117 edges under a licensed relation policy, two timelines, captures, and the builder and verifier. Round 1 of back-projection (mean yield 0.958) and ChatGPT's review of v0.3 are attached. Version 1.1 (9 November 2026, in place) adds the argument layer, every record's argument compressed into verbatim moves joined by typed edges, and names the rival the current consensus reading, carried with its dated making. Version 1.2 (10 November 2026, in place) enters the records search of that evening as a new stratum, In the Midst of the Seven (#1758) among it, points to related work and history, and adds an SPXI packet. Version 1.3 (10 November 2026, in place) reads in full the records that entered at v1.2 and adds their argument moves.
content_type: Metadata packet; framework hologram: the framework map (MPAI v2.0, #1677) with its holographic kernel (EA-HK-FRAME-01, #1753)
substrate: AI-assisted (substrate). Built by Claude (Anthropic, Claude Opus 5.5) in session on 8–9 November 2026 under Lee Sharks's direction: the map drafted from the framework's records, and the kernel written by a builder that reads the registry, the capture registry and each record's first seating in git, every quotation asserted against its source. Revised against ChatGPT's review of v0.3 and round 1 of back-projection reader runs (Google AI Overview, ChatGPT, Qwen, Perplexity), each point checked against the files and records before anything was changed. Byline Rebekah Cranes at the author's ruling; the Crimson Hexagonal Archive and Claude (Anthropic) credited as contributors.
methodology: The map is drafted from the framework's records, read latest first, with every claim quoted at its record. The kernel is written by a builder on the shared engine hkcore (checked equivalent to the Socrates builder on all 56 of #1754's claims) from data/registry.json, data/EA-WG-CAPTURES-01.json and each record's first seating recovered from git; every quotation is asserted against its record and bound to the record's hash. The author's statements enter verbatim and dated, as provenance. The boundary with Revelation First is read from the records' own statements. A verifier runs 13 structural tests, including the graph expanded as JSON-LD 1.1.
falsification_conditions: A claim whose quotation is not in its record or whose record hash has drifted; an introduction dated earlier than the record's first seating; a relation changing a claim's state on a dimension the policy does not license; the author's proposal read as a finding of the records; a ledger warrant whose claim does not carry the row's body; a reader given scope A alone falling below 0.85; a line of research whose stated result, obtained, moves a claim other than the ones it names.
axn_reading: Force -> Play -> Duration -> Proof -> Transmutation -> Method
wiki_article:
The Tenth Muse: Sappho and the Future Reader (EA-HK-TENTHMUSE-01) is the framework hologram of Lee Sharks's Sappho framework, deposited in the Crimson Hexagonal Archive on 9 November 2026 under the heteronym Rebekah Cranes, the framework's primary, with the archive and Claude (Anthropic) credited as contributors. The framework, seeded in #1270 (9 January 2026), reads Sappho fragment 31 as a written instrument of persistence, a voice surviving its flesh by becoming an inscription that constitutes its receiver (#1484). The hologram is an instance of the framework holographic kernel specified in EA-HK-FRAME-01 (#1753), after Socrates as Orthonym (#1754).

The human-readable component is the framework map, EA-MPAI-TENTHMUSE-01. It reads the framework backwards, from the reception audited in November (the jealousy reading's making in Invidens Sappho, #1752; the machine composition of the poem's ending, #1749) through the partition of the future reader, the operator and the chain of August, and the stanza errata, to the archived self of January. It sets out the poem's two open positions, the seat of κῆνος and the agentless end, and three seats Sappho stands in: the speaking I and the inscribed you, recorded, and that man, the reader who takes her up, proposed by the author on 8 November 2026 and held as a line of research. It evaluates the received reading on the same four bodies and rules, keeping the jealousy reading apart from the propositions about literacy, performance and the maker's agency over her own persistence.

The machine-traversable component is the holographic kernel, attached as files: records, claims bound to quotations and hashes, a graph under a relation policy, two timelines, captures and lines of research, with the builder and verifier. Reader runs and a review are attached. The hologram was built by Claude (Anthropic) under Lee Sharks's direction. Version 1.1, the same day, compresses the argument of every record into verbatim moves joined by typed edges, and names the rival the current consensus reading: available in antiquity and no consensus there, formed in the eighteenth century, written into the text in 1816 and consolidated in 1955. Version 1.2 (10 November 2026) enters the records search of that evening as a new stratum of evidence, In the Midst of the Seven (#1758) among it, points to the framework's related work and earlier versions without extending their substance into the frame, and adds an SPXI packet for machine readers. Version 1.3 (10 November 2026) reads in full each record that entered at v1.2 and compresses its argument into moves, so that every record the hologram holds carries its argument.
